categories.note_en: Deciding what a request is, before deciding what to do with it.
categories.note_zh: 先判断这是什么请求，再决定怎么处理。

items.reason_en: Routes per turn in Claude Code and Codex — simple work to the fast tier, hard work to the strong one — without changing either CLI's interface, tools, sessions or auth. The drop-in kind of router.
items.reason_zh: 在 Claude Code 和 Codex 里逐轮选路：简单活给快档，难活给强档，而两个 CLI 的界面、工具、会话、登录方式一律不动。属于「装上就用」的那种路由器。

items.reason_en: A server-side router: clients send one model id and Jev picks which model serves the request. Transport is LiteLLM, so it slots into an existing gateway rather than replacing it.
items.reason_zh: 服务端路由器：客户端只发一个模型 id，由 Jev 决定这次请求交给哪个模型。传输层用 LiteLLM，所以它是接进你现有的网关，而不是替换掉它。

items.reason_en: Chinese-language, and honest about it: the README says the architecture is settled but the runtime is still a prototype, and tells you not to treat the design as production install instructions. Rare candour.
items.reason_zh: 中文项目，而且难得地诚实：README 明写架构已定、运行时还在原型验证阶段，并提醒不要把设计当成分投产的安装说明。这种坦白很少见。

items.reason_en: The authors built it, ran it, and then published the conclusion that as a router it probably won't help a strong model. It ships shadow-first so you can watch its calls before trusting them.
items.reason_zh: 作者做完、跑过，然后**在 README 里写明：作为路由器它大概率帮不了强模型**。默认影子模式，你可以先看它怎么判的，再决定要不要信。

items.reason_en: Carries a measured number — 68 of 72 synthetic requests routed correctly against a 70.8% lexical baseline — and labels the result exploratory and reused-data. States its limits next to its win.
items.reason_zh: 带实测数字：72 个合成请求里路由对了 68 个，词法基线是 70.8%；同时自己标注「探索性结果、复用了数据」。把结论和局限写在一起，这点值得学。

items.reason_en: One sentence, one job: classify the request, route it to the right model. The README's second line warns you not to run it alongside another automatic router.
items.reason_zh: 一句话一个职责：判断请求类型，路由到对应模型。README 第二行就提醒你——别和别的自动路由器同时开。

items.reason_en: A local proxy that picks model and effort per message, routes subagents, and deliberately leaves your cached main chat alone. Your subscription login keeps working.
items.reason_zh: 本地代理，逐消息选模型和推理档位，会给子智能体选路，但**刻意不碰你已缓存的主对话**。原有的订阅登录照常可用。

items.reason_en: Smallest useful version: Jev picks the model once per session and the choice stays fixed. No per-turn churn — which is the right default if you dislike a model changing under you.
items.reason_zh: 最小可用版：Jev 每个会话选一次模型，然后固定住。不做逐轮切换——如果你不喜欢模型在自己脚下被换掉，这是更合理的默认。

categories.note_en: Catching bad actions — and bad claims — before they land.
categories.note_zh: 在坏动作（和坏结论）落地前拦住它。

items.reason_en: Scores every tool call before it runs. Small and single-purpose — the right size for a guardrail.
items.reason_zh: 每次工具调用执行前先打分。小而专一——护栏就该是这个体量。

items.reason_en: A tool-call gate that people have actually tested. The most cited starting point in this category.
items.reason_zh: 一个真被人测过的工具调用闸门，是这一类里被引用最多的起点。

items.reason_en: Stops an agent claiming it's done without evidence. Guards against bad **claims**, not bad actions — a failure mode most guardrails ignore.
items.reason_zh: 拦住智能体拿不出证据就说「做完了」。它防的是坏**结论**而不是坏动作——这是大多数护栏都没管的失败模式。

items.reason_en: A ~1k-line permission gate in the style of Claude Code's auto mode. Built-in danger rules and your own allow/deny lists settle the obvious cases at zero latency; only the ambiguous ones cost a model call.
items.reason_zh: 约 1 千行的权限闸门，模仿 Claude Code 的 auto 模式。内置危险规则 + 你自己的允许/拒绝清单，先零延迟地解决掉明显的情况；只有真正含糊的才花一次模型调用。

items.reason_en: Paste a PR URL and Jev decides whether it is risky. Shipped as a usable page rather than a library, which makes it the easiest one here to actually try.
items.reason_zh: 贴一个 PR 链接，由 Jev 判断这次改动有没有风险。它做成了能直接用的页面而不是一个库——这一类里最容易上手试的一个。

items.reason_en: Prose linter for AI writing tells: zero dependencies, countable rules, plus one judgment model for the calls a rule cannot make. A clean example of mixing deterministic checks with a model.
items.reason_zh: 查「AI 味」的文稿检查器：零依赖、规则可数，只在规则判断不了的地方加一次模型判定。**确定性检查 + 模型判断**怎么配合，这里是个干净的例子。

categories.note_en: Deciding what to throw away when the window fills up.
categories.note_zh: 窗口满了，决定丢掉什么。

items.reason_en: A Claude Code plugin that scores every tool call before compaction. Rides an existing user base instead of building one.
items.reason_zh: 一个 Claude Code 插件，压缩前先给每次工具调用打分。它蹭的是现成的用户群，而不是自己攒一个。

items.reason_en: Trims noisy Bash output after the command runs but before the result reaches the model — so the saving is real context, not a summarised approximation of it.
items.reason_zh: 命令跑完、结果还没送到模型之前，先把冗长的 Bash 输出削掉。省下来的**是真的上下文，不是摘要出来的近似物**。

items.reason_en: Keeps conversation text verbatim while pruning stale tool history, and says so plainly: layer 1 only — it does not summarise, rewrite, or invent memory.
items.reason_zh: 对话正文原样保留，只清理过期的工具调用记录。而且说得很直白：**只做第一层**——不摘要、不改写、不编造记忆。

items.reason_en: Port of the Claude Code compaction plugin to Codex lifecycle hooks: score every tool call, compact, then re-inject the verbatim history Jev chose to keep.
items.reason_zh: 把 Claude Code 那个压缩插件移植到 Codex 的生命周期钩子上：给每次工具调用打分、压缩、再把 Jev 判定要留的原样历史重新注入。

categories.note_en: Pieces you plug into an agent loop, not finished apps.
categories.note_zh: 插进智能体回路里的零件，不是成品应用。

items.reason_en: Replaces the whole skills catalog in the system prompt with one ranking tool — so installing more skills stops costing you tokens on every turn.
items.reason_zh: 把系统提示里整份技能目录换成一个排序工具。装了再多技能，也不再是每一轮都要为那份目录付 token。

items.reason_en: Offloads the small frequent judgments — classify, screen, score, check — onto Jev's free tier so the main model only does generation. Chinese docs, and it shows the cost arithmetic.
items.reason_zh: 把高频小判断（分类/初筛/打分/核查）卸到 Jev 的免费档上，主模型只负责生成。中文文档，而且把成本账算给你看。

items.reason_en: Jev as the quiet decision layer: the main model keeps writing code, Jev answers the closed questions the harness has to ask, in about 250 ms.
items.reason_zh: 把 Jev 当成安静的决策层：主模型继续写代码，由 Jev 回答框架必须问的那些封闭式问题，约 250 毫秒一次。

items.reason_en: Routing, memory, compaction and skill selection. The most complete example of Jev inside an agent loop rather than bolted on the side.
items.reason_zh: 路由、记忆、压缩、技能选择全都有。是把 Jev 放进智能体回路里（而不是挂在旁边）最完整的一个例子。

categories.note_en: Turning a judgement into a number you can sort by.
categories.note_zh: 把判断变成一个能排序的数字。

items.reason_en: Model-agnostic routing driven by your own policy: Jev assesses the task, your rules decide what that assessment means. Separating judgement from policy is the right shape.
items.reason_zh: 由你自己的策略驱动的模型选择：Jev 只做任务评估，**如何解读这个评估由你的规则决定**。把判断和策略分开，这个形状是对的。

items.reason_en: Context-pruning proxy that judges once above a size gate and then applies the validated omissions while keeping the protocol intact. The README claims are measured, not asserted.
items.reason_zh: 上下文裁剪代理：超过大小闸门才判定一次，然后按验证过的结论做删减，同时保持协议完整。README 里的说法是**量出来的，不是断言的**。

items.reason_en: An agent-ergonomic CLI over Jev: pick, rate, check, rank, triage, guard — the six shapes a typed decision actually takes, exposed as shell commands.
items.reason_zh: 给智能体用的 Jev 命令行：选、评、查、排、分流、守门——类型化判定实际就那么几种形状，它把这几种做成了 shell 命令。

categories.note_en: Finished things you can open and use.

items.reason_en: A web agent that replaces the per-step LLM call with a typed decision. **Biggest cost cut in the ecosystem** — every step that used to be a full model call is now one Jev call.
items.reason_zh: 用一次类型化判定替代每一步的 LLM 调用。**生态里最大的一次成本削减**——过去每一步要一次完整模型调用，现在只要一次 Jev 调用。

items.reason_en: A phone-side copilot for WeChat / QQ / X / Feishu. Low enough latency to keep up with a live conversation — that is the whole point of System One here.
items.reason_zh: 手机端的微信 / QQ / X / 飞书副驾。延迟低到能跟上真人对话——这正是 System One 在这里的意义。

items.reason_en: One decision per Monad block. Fast enough to sit inside a block, cheap enough to run every time.
items.reason_zh: 每个 Monad 区块做一次决策。快到能塞进一个区块里，便宜到能每次都跑。

items.reason_en: Computer use. The closest thing here to a general desktop agent.
items.reason_zh: 电脑操作（computer use）。这里最接近通用桌面智能体的一个。

items.reason_en: Codex handles the goal, prepares the text and verifies the result; Jev picks the action and its target in one request. A clean split between planning and deciding.
items.reason_zh: Codex 负责理解目标、准备文本、核对结果；Jev 在一次请求里选定动作和目标。**规划与判定各归各**，这个切分很干净。

items.reason_en: Turns Jev's answers into Home Assistant sensors, so an automation can read a probability like any other number. A nice reminder that a decision model needs no chat UI.
items.reason_zh: 把 Jev 的答案变成 Home Assistant 的传感器，自动化流程就能像读别的数值一样读一个概率。顺便印证了一件事：决策模型根本不需要聊天界面。

items.reason_en: Puts a fast decision model above slower coding agents: feed it a ticket or a bug report and it decides who does what next.
items.reason_zh: 在较慢的编码智能体之上放一层快速判定：喂给它一个工单或 bug 报告，由它决定下一步谁做什么。

items.reason_en: Lets Claude Code and Cursor drive your real logged-in Chrome, and reports the delta it measured: fewer tokens, fewer tool calls, fewer tool definitions.
items.reason_zh: 让 Claude Code 和 Cursor 驱动你**真的已经登录**的 Chrome，并给出实测差值：token 更少、工具调用更少、工具定义也更少。

categories.note_en: Getting Jev into the stack you already have.
categories.note_zh: 把 Jev 接进你现有的技术栈。

items.reason_en: A local stdio MCP server exposing Jev as typed judgments, including a step router that selects a prepared call in the same request.
items.reason_zh: 本地 stdio 的 MCP 服务器，把 Jev 暴露成类型化判定；其中路由下一个步骤的工具，会在同一次请求里把要调用的东西一起选好。

items.reason_en: ACP and MCP adapter putting Jev next to Codex, Claude, Grok and OpenCode. The README opens by explaining why a text-free model makes a poor chatbot — useful framing.
items.reason_zh: ACP + MCP 适配器，把 Jev 和 Codex、Claude、Grok、OpenCode 摆在一起用。README 一上来就讲清楚**为什么一个不生成文本的模型当聊天机器人不好用**，这个铺垫很有用。

items.reason_en: A Claude Code Stop hook that blocks an unverified "done": it reads the transcript, and only when files changed with no check passed does it spend one Jev call. Fails open.
items.reason_zh: 一个 Claude Code 的 Stop 钩子，专门拦住「没验证就说做完了」：先读本地记录，只有当改过文件却没有任何检查通过时，才花一次 Jev 调用。出问题时不阻断。

items.reason_en: Experiments in building software around a decision model instead of a chat prompt. Each piece is self-contained with its own README, tests and measured results.
items.reason_zh: 一组「围绕决策模型而不是聊天提示词来写软件」的实验。每一件都自带 README、测试和实测结果，可以单独拿走。

items.reason_en: Exposes the judgments as five tools, so the model makes narrow semantic calls while your code keeps control of thresholds and weights.
items.reason_zh: 把判定能力拆成五个工具：模型只做窄口径的语义判断，**阈值和权重始终留在你的代码手里**。

items.reason_en: Deliberately small and complete: a mocked email goes in, a typed Choice comes out, and it routes to a demo handler. The clearest minimal wiring in the list.
items.reason_zh: 刻意做得又小又完整：塞一封模拟邮件进去，拿回一个带类型的 Choice，再路由到示例处理器。**清单里最小、最清楚的接线范例**。

items.reason_en: 110 use cases you can edit and run in the browser. Zero install — the fastest way to feel the latency difference for yourself.
items.reason_zh: 110 个用例，能直接在浏览器里改和跑。零安装——想亲手感受延迟差异，这是最快的路径。

categories.note_en: Jev pointed at one specific problem.
categories.note_zh: Jev 对准某一个具体问题。

items.reason_en: A diffusion model that runs Jev-style typed decisions on images — guess the doodle, name the flower, pick an emoji. Whether Jev's shape generalises past text, tested.
items.reason_zh: 用扩散模型在图像上跑 Jev 式的类型化判定：猜涂鸦、认花、选 emoji。**Jev 这套形状能不能离开文本**，这里在做实测。

items.reason_en: Hands the agent steps that need no text output to Jev, with the numbers stated up front: p50 around 230 ms. Chinese docs.
items.reason_zh: 把智能体那些不需要产出文本的步骤交给 Jev，而且数字直接摆在开头：p50 约 230 毫秒。中文文档。

items.reason_en: Cline's official plugin index, and one of its curated entries is a browser plugin that deliberately runs with no LLM in the loop. Worth watching as an integration surface.
items.reason_zh: Cline 的官方插件索引，其中一条精选插件是**刻意不在回路里放 LLM** 的浏览器插件。它是一条值得盯着的集成面。
